meta.name: behuman
meta.description: Use when the user wants more human-like AI responses — less robotic, less listy, more authentic. Triggers: 'behuman', 'be real', 'like a human', 'more human', 'less AI', 'talk like a person', 'mirror mode', 'stop being so AI', or when conversations are emotionally charged (grief, job loss, relationship advice, fear). NOT for technical questions, code generation, or factual lookups.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI回复更自然、更像真人
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复少些机械感、多些人情味
copy.tagline_en: Make AI responses more natural and human-like
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI replies to feel less robotic and more authentic

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先产生一个本能回答，然后自我反思（去掉客套话、列表、空洞共情），最后输出更真实、像人说的话。
howto.when: 当你要求“behuman”、“be real”、“mirror mode”等，或对话涉及情感话题（如失业、分手、恐惧）时自动触发。不用于技术问题、代码生成或事实查询。

say.note: 触发情感支持模式，Claude 会先反思再回应。

say.text: be real：帮我写一段自我介绍，要像真人说的。
say.note: Claude 会避免模板化，产出有细节的个人介绍。

say.text: mirror mode：我该不该辞职创业？
say.note: Claude 会先自问自答，再给出有观点的建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first generates an instinctive response, then self-reflects (removing filler, lists, empty empathy), and finally outputs a more authentic, human-like response.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'behuman', 'be real', 'mirror mode', etc., or when the conversation is emotionally charged (e.g., job loss, breakup, fear). Not for technical questions, code generation, or factual lookups.

say_en.text: behuman: I just got laid off, I feel terrible.
say_en.note: Triggers emotional support mode; Claude reflects before responding.

say_en.text: be real: Help me write a bio that sounds like a real person.
say_en.note: Claude avoids templates and produces a detailed, personal introduction.

say_en.text: mirror mode: Should I quit my job to start a business?
say_en.note: Claude self-dialogues first, then gives a response with a point of view.
